ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Applied Mathematics students and MBA students. Interested MAS students should contact Melinda Ohlsson to add their names to the course request list. The Finance Department will work with Melinda to place MAS students into 400-level Finance courses. Graduate students from other programs should contact the Finance Department directly about the possibility of enrolling.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Applied Mathematics or Business Administration (MBA) major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
